2608.07019.title: ReQuant: Fixed-Grid Discrete Refinement for Post-Training Quantization
2608.07019.paper_summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the memory and computational cost of large language models. Existing PTQ methods typically obtain an initial quantized model through heuristic rules or greedy optimization, and once quantization is completed the resulting integer assignments are usually treated as final. This observation motivates a complementary optimization stage within PTQ that keeps quantized weights improvable after an executable quantized model has been produced, while preserving the quantized format. We introduce ReQuant, a backpropagation-free fixed-grid refinement procedure for this stage. Agnostic to the PTQ initializer, ReQuant takes an existing quantized model as a feasible starting point and iteratively revisits its discrete weight assignments on the fixed quantization grid. Accepted updates strictly reduce the mean squared reconstruction error and remain on the original grid. In this way, ReQuant turns the initially fixed PTQ output into an iteratively optimizable discrete solution and serves as a plug-and-play post-processing stage for existing PTQ pipelines. Experiments across diverse model families, bit-widths, and downstream tasks show that ReQuant consistently improves quantized models from heterogeneous PTQ initializers, with especially large gains on simple initializers and lower bit-widths. Notably, ReQuant can refine a simple round-to-nearest initialization across multiple sweeps until it approaches or surpasses GPTAQ under the same quantization format. These results establish ReQuant as a practical complementary stage for further improving existing PTQ pipelines.
2608.07019.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練量化（PTQ）被廣泛用於降低大型語言模型的記憶體和計算成本。現有的PTQ方法通常通過啟發式規則或貪婪優化獲得初始的量化模型，並且一旦量化完成，所得到的整數分配通常被視為最終結果。這一觀察促使在PTQ內部引入一個補充優化階段，使得在生成可執行的量化模型後，量化權重仍可改進，同時保持量化格式。我們引入了ReQuant，一種無需反向傳播的固定網格精煉程序來實現這一階段。ReQuant對PTQ初始化器不敏感，將現有的量化模型作為可行的起點，並在固定的量化網格上迭代地重新檢視其離散權重分配。接受的更新嚴格減少均方重建誤差並保持在原始網格上。通過這種方式，ReQuant將最初固定的PTQ輸出轉變為可迭代優化的離散解，並作為現有PTQ管道的即插即用後處理階段。在不同模型系列、位寬和下游任務上的實驗顯示，ReQuant始終能改善來自異質PTQ初始化器的量化模型，特別是在簡單初始化器和較低位寬上獲得了特別大的增益。值得注意的是，ReQuant可以在多次迭代中精煉簡單的四捨五入初始化，直到其接近或超越在相同量化格式下的GPTAQ。這些結果確立了ReQuant作為進一步改善現有PTQ管道的實用補充階段。
